sources.sql: WITH top_groups_2014 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND NOT ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT tg.DISPLAY_NAME AS group_display_name, tg.LAUNCHED_AT AS group_launched_at, tg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology AS group_has_numa_topology, COUNT(fi.instance_uuid) AS forge_instance_count_in_group, MAX(CASE WHEN fi.has_deleted_instance_extra = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_forge_instance_has_deleted_instance_extra FROM top_groups_2014 AS tg LEFT JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = tg.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.LAUNCHED_AT = tg.LAUNCHED_AT LEFT JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.instance_uuid = i.UUID GROUP BY tg.DISPLAY_NAME, tg.LAUNCHED_AT, tg.max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology ORDER BY tg.max_memory_mb DESC

sources.sql: WITH confirmed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed'), avg_rank AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT c.status, c.source_compute, c.dest_compute, c.display_name, c.network_info, c.window_column, a.avg_window_column, (c.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN avg_rank AS a), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, cm.network_info AS migration_network_info, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_status, cm.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank_across_confirmed, cm.deviation_from_avg_dense_rank, fi.instance_uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.display_name AS forge_display_name, fi.vm_state AS forge_vm_state, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.vcpus AS forge_vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id AS forge_instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at AS forge_instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info AS forge_network_info, fi.window_column AS forge_min_instance_extra_id_window, fi.has_deleted_instance_extra FROM confirmed_migrations AS cm JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.display_name = cm.display_name

sources.sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.hostname, id.display_name, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.flavor_json, id.numa_topology_json, id.network_info_json, id.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_vcpu_count, cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_in_migration_window FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN CompletedMigrations AS cm ON cm.INSTANCE_UUID = id.instance_uuid

sources.sql: WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, instance_uuid, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, instance_extra_created_at, network_info, window_column FROM q1_inner_cte ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid), q2_inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS t0 JOIN `instance_extra` AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2_avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(t0.ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM `instances` AS t0 WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2 AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.window_column AS rank_within_az_by_id, (t0.ID - a.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q2_inner_cte AS i JOIN `instances` AS t0 ON t0.UUID = i.UUID CROSS JOIN q2_avg_ids AS a) SELECT q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count, SUM(q1.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(SUM(q1.vcpus) / NULLIF(SUM(q1.memory_mb), 0), 6) AS normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio, ROUND(AVG(q2.deviation_from_avg_instance_id), 2) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.UUID = q1.instance_uuid GROUP BY q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio DESC

sources.sql: WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(hcm.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC

sources.sql: WITH RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC), Flare3FlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT r.display_name, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_stddev, f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor_json, f.numa_topology_json, f.network_info_json, f.window_column FROM RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS r JOIN Flare3FlareInstances AS f ON f.display_name = r.display_name ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC

sources.sql: WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC

metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_cte AS v JOIN metadata_cte AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, m.metadata_key, m.window_column

sources.sql: WITH vm_state_memory_thresholds AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0)) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, threshold_stats.avg_plus_stddev AS avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(i3.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i3.memory_mb) AS avg_plus_stddev FROM `instances` AS i3 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid WHERE i3.deleted = 0) AS threshold_stats), instance_project_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id) SELECT ips.instance_id, ips.instance_uuid, ips.user_id, ips.project_id, ips.display_name, ips.vm_state, ips.memory_mb, ips.vcpus, ips.info_cache_id, ips.max_instance_id_next_2, ips.total_instances_in_project, ips.avg_instance_count, vst.total_memory_mb AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, vst.avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM instance_project_window_stats AS ips JOIN vm_state_memory_thresholds AS vst ON ips.vm_state = vst.vm_state ORDER BY ips.instance_id

sources.sql: WITH top_projects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON ic.uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND ic.window_column = 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_rank1_instance_by_window FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ORDER BY total_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), instance_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id) SELECT tp.project_id, tp.total_memory_mb, tp.has_rank1_instance_by_window, id.instance_id, id.instance_uuid, id.user_id, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.info_cache_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, id.total_instances_in_project, id.avg_instance_count FROM top_projects AS tp JOIN instance_details AS id ON id.project_id = tp.project_id ORDER BY tp.total_memory_mb DESC, id.instance_id

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT d.instance_id, d.display_name, d.user_id, d.project_id, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.availability_zone, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_value, d.metadata_id, d.window_column, s.metadata_count_range, s.metadata_count_variance, s.metadata_count_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataDetails AS d JOIN MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS s ON d.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_id) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.display_name, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.metadata_id, ic.window_column, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, agg.total_vcpus_for_display_name, agg.total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_for_display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM `instances` AS i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name) AS agg ON ic.display_name = agg.display_name ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_id

sources.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS FLOAT)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS FLOAT) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name

sources.sql: WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC), CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.`KEY` ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, aw.avg_window_column AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > aw.avg_window_column THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_ROWNUM' WHEN ic.window_column < aw.avg_window_column THEN 'BELOW_AVG_ROWNUM' ELSE 'AT_AVG_ROWNUM' END AS rownum_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_window AS aw) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.instance_display_name, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.max_memory_mb, cmr.metadata_key, cmr.metadata_value, cmr.window_column, cmr.benchmark, cmr.rownum_category FROM CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum AS cmr JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cmr.instance_display_name ORDER BY ms.avg_memory_mb DESC, cmr.migration_id, cmr.metadata_key

sources.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism JOIN `instances` AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ism2.`KEY` <> 'image_image_type' AND ism2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_other_system_metadata FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.network_info, q2.avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, q2.has_other_system_metadata FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_total_stddev DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_value

sources.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Enriched AS (SELECT ic.display_name, ism2.value AS image_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m WHERE (m.source_compute = i.host OR m.dest_compute = i.host) AND m.deleted = 0 AND NOT m.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS host_migration_status, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism2.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism2.deleted = 0 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic2 ON iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(image_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE host_migration_status END AS host_migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM Enriched GROUP BY image_type, host_migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name) SELECT q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name

sources.sql: WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sr.vm_state, sr.power_state

ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key) SELECT q2.hostname, q2.instance_uuid, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS running_avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.has_deleted_system_metadata, q1.migration_id, q1.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q1.DEST_COMPUTE, q1.instance_display_name, q1.window_column AS running_avg_migration_id, q1.total_metadata_rows, q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id, ROUND(q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id / NULLIF(q2.window_column, 0), 6) AS normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.INSTANCE_UUID = q2.instance_uuid AND q1.metadata_key = q2.metadata_key AND q1.metadata_value = q2.metadata_value ORDER BY normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), DisplayNameImageTypeStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.value HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, SUM(instance_count) AS total_instances FROM DisplayNameImageTypeStats GROUP BY display_name, image_type WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY GROUPING(display_name), display_name, GROUPING(image_type), image_type

sources.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS (SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC), AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS (SELECT i.PROTOCOL, AVG(i.max_to_port * 1.0) AS avg_max_to_port FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.PROTOCOL) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS a ON a.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL WHERE i.max_to_port > (SELECT a2.avg_max_to_port FROM AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS a2 WHERE a2.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL) ORDER BY i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port DESC

MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_name) OVER (ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol) = security_group_name THEN NULL ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, protocol, max_to_port, from_port_range, from_port_variance, qualifying_protocols FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS sg_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.PROTOCOL END AS protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(i.max_to_port) ELSE i.max_to_port END AS max_to_port, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_range END AS from_port_range, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_variance END AS from_port_variance, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS qualifying_protocols FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_variance DESC), tcp_rule_counts AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(*) AS tcp_rule_count FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME), avg_tcp_rule_count AS (SELECT AVG(tcp_rule_count * 1.0) AS avg_tcp_rule_count FROM tcp_rule_counts) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.from_port_variance, trc.tcp_rule_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN tcp_rule_counts AS trc ON i.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name CROSS JOIN avg_tcp_rule_count AS a WHERE trc.tcp_rule_count > a.avg_tcp_rule_count ORDER BY i.from_port_variance DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each of the top 10 (display name, launched-at timestamp) groups with the highest maximum memory among instances launched in 2014 (only keeping groups where that maximum exceeds 16000 MB), show the group’s display name, launched-at timestamp, maximum memory, whether any instance in the group has a non-empty NUMA topology recorded, how many instances in that group are the display name 'forge', and whether any of those 'forge' instances has an instance-extra record marked as deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH top_groups_2014 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND NOT ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT tg.DISPLAY_NAME AS group_display_name, tg.LAUNCHED_AT AS group_launched_at, tg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology AS group_has_numa_topology, COUNT(fi.instance_uuid) AS forge_instance_count_in_group, MAX(CASE WHEN fi.has_deleted_instance_extra = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_forge_instance_has_deleted_instance_extra FROM top_groups_2014 AS tg LEFT JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = tg.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.LAUNCHED_AT = tg.LAUNCHED_AT LEFT JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.instance_uuid = i.UUID GROUP BY tg.DISPLAY_NAME, tg.LAUNCHED_AT, tg.max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology ORDER BY tg.max_memory_mb DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the top 10 system metadata keys (by number of rows) used by instances in availability zone "flare3", show the metadata key, how many rows it has, how many distinct instances it appears on, the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) across those instances, and whether any of those instances have a non-null migration context in their instance extra record. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT inner_cte.metadata_key AS metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS metadata_row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS distinct_instance_count, SUM(inner_cte.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(inner_cte.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 WHERE ie2.INSTANCE_UUID IN (SELECT DISTINCT inner_cte2.instance_uuid FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 WHERE inner_cte2.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key) AND NOT ie2.MIGRATION_CONTEXT IS NULL) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_migration_context FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.metadata_key ORDER BY metadata_row_count DESC LIMIT 10

target_disjoint_workload.question: For confirmed migrations and for instances whose display name is 'forge', return a combined report (joined by instance display name) that includes the migration status, source and destination compute hosts, the instance display name and network_info, the dense rank within each migration status plus the overall average dense-rank across confirmed migrations and each row’s deviation from that average; and also includes the forge instance UUID, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance-extra ID and created timestamp, cached network_info JSON, the minimum instance-extra ID in a 3-preceding/1-following window ordered by memory, and whether the instance has any deleted instance-extra record. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH confirmed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed'), avg_rank AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT c.status, c.source_compute, c.dest_compute, c.display_name, c.network_info, c.window_column, a.avg_window_column, (c.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN avg_rank AS a), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, cm.network_info AS migration_network_info, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_status, cm.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank_across_confirmed, cm.deviation_from_avg_dense_rank, fi.instance_uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.display_name AS forge_display_name, fi.vm_state AS forge_vm_state, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.vcpus AS forge_vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id AS forge_instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at AS forge_instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info AS forge_network_info, fi.window_column AS forge_min_instance_extra_id_window, fi.has_deleted_instance_extra FROM confirmed_migrations AS cm JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.display_name = cm.display_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" whose display name matches the pattern "flare", and that also have a "completed" migration with an instance display name matching "flare", provide the instance UUID, hostname, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance-extra flavor JSON, the instance-extra NUMA topology JSON, the cached network_info JSON, the minimum memory (MB) within each vCPU count, along with the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance-extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (MB) in a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.hostname, id.display_name, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.flavor_json, id.numa_topology_json, id.network_info_json, id.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_vcpu_count, cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_in_migration_window FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN CompletedMigrations AS cm ON cm.INSTANCE_UUID = id.instance_uuid

target_disjoint_workload.question: For “forge” instances, for each availability zone list the availability zone, the number of “forge” instances, the total vCPUs, the normalized vCPU-per-MB ratio (total vCPUs divided by total memory in MB, rounded), and the average deviation of instance ID from the overall average “forge” instance ID (rounded).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, instance_uuid, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, instance_extra_created_at, network_info, window_column FROM q1_inner_cte ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid), q2_inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS t0 JOIN `instance_extra` AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2_avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(t0.ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM `instances` AS t0 WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2 AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.window_column AS rank_within_az_by_id, (t0.ID - a.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q2_inner_cte AS i JOIN `instances` AS t0 ON t0.UUID = i.UUID CROSS JOIN q2_avg_ids AS a) SELECT q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count, SUM(q1.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(SUM(q1.vcpus) / NULLIF(SUM(q1.memory_mb), 0), 6) AS normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio, ROUND(AVG(q2.deviation_from_avg_instance_id), 2) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.UUID = q1.instance_uuid GROUP BY q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12' where the instance display name matches the pattern 'flare', for each migration type list the number of completed migrations, the average instance memory (MB), the average instance vCPUs, the average of the per-type minimum migration memory_total (from the windowed minimum), and the average running average of migration id (from the windowed running average).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(hcm.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances whose display name appears on host 'blaze8-12' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type', and that also have matching instances in availability zone 'flare3' with a display name matching the pattern 'flare', show the display name’s average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of ROOT_GB along with each matching instance’s UUID, hostname, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor JSON, NUMA topology JSON, cached network_info JSON, and the minimum memory_mb within each vCPU count. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC), Flare3FlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT r.display_name, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_stddev, f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor_json, f.numa_topology_json, f.network_info_json, f.window_column FROM RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS r JOIN Flare3FlareInstances AS f ON f.display_name = r.display_name ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each instance display name matching the pattern "prime" (with non-deleted instances and only completed migrations), show the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory in MB, and indicate whether there are any "flare" instances in availability zone "flare3" whose memory in MB equals that average (also returning the count of such flare3/flare instances). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list each instance’s VM state (suppressing repeats when the VM state is the same as the previous row), instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance extra ID, along with the instance extra flavor JSON and each system metadata key/value; also include the row number within each VM state (ordered by instance UUID), the row number within each metadata key group (ordered by instance UUID), and for each metadata key the total number of matching rows and the average number of rows per key across all keys in this filtered set. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH metadata_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_cte AS v JOIN metadata_cte AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, m.metadata_key, m.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12", list each instance’s (possibly de-duplicated) VM state, instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance extra ID, along with the instance extra flavor JSON and system metadata key/value; also include the row number within each VM state (ordered by instance UUID) and the row number within each metadata key group (ordered by instance UUID), plus for each metadata key the total number of matching rows for that key and the average number of rows per key across all keys in this filtered set. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH metadata_rows AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_rows AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_rows AS v JOIN metadata_rows AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, m.metadata_key, m.window_column

target_disjoint_workload.question: List (1) each non-deleted instance display name matching the pattern 'prime' with its cache-update time coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) as a benchmark, and a variability category, and (2) each instance in availability zone 'flare3' whose display name matches the pattern 'flare' with its deviation from the overall average memory (using that overall average as the benchmark), returning a combined result set with a reason indicating which rule produced each row. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each display name as 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% above the benchmark), 'LOW_VARIABILITY' (at least 50% below the benchmark), or 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY'.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH prime_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC), flare_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb), CombinedResults AS (SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability AS pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory AS fm) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances with display name equal to 'forge' that are also non-deleted and in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state with a non-deleted instance info cache record, list the forge instance display name, instance UUID, memory (MB), cached network info, cache record ID, the running average memory (MB) within the display name group ordered by memory, the total number of 'forge' instances and overall average forge memory (MB), plus the instance hostname, vCPUs, cache last-updated timestamp, and the forge-to-shelved-offloaded memory ratio (rounded).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column, forge_stats.total_forge_instances, forge_stats.avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ic.UPDATED_AT AS cache_updated_at FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0) SELECT fi.display_name, fi.uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.network_info AS forge_cached_network_info, fi.cache_id AS forge_cache_id, fi.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, fi.total_forge_instances, fi.avg_forge_memory_mb, so.hostname AS shelved_offloaded_hostname, so.memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb, so.vcpus AS shelved_offloaded_vcpus, so.cache_updated_at AS shelved_offloaded_cache_updated_at, ROUND(fi.memory_mb / NULLIF(so.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS forge_to_shelved_offloaded_memory_ratio FROM forge_instances AS fi JOIN shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS so ON so.instance_uuid = fi.uuid ORDER BY fi.memory_mb

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances with display name "forge" that are in the "shelved_offloaded" VM state and have memory (MB) greater than the average "forge" memory (MB) in their availability zone, list the instance details (ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM/power state, memory, vCPUs, availability zone, instance-info-cache ID and network info, and the per-project minimum memory window value) along with the "shelved_offloaded" migration summary for completed migrations (minimum instance memory, total migration memory processed, and whether any related instances have a non-deleted network info cache record). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS (SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.USER_ID, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.POWER_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ZoneAverages AS za ON za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY q1.availability_zone, q1.project_id, q1.instance_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For non-deleted instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state whose display name is in the top 10 display names with the largest MEMORY_MB range among non-deleted instances, list the instance UUID, display name, power state, system metadata key and value, cached network_info JSON, and the per-key row number (ordered by instance UUID). Also show, per metadata key, the total rows and average power state (suppressing repeated metadata keys), along with the display name’s memory range, variance, standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and whether it has any non-deleted instance_info_cache record. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH shelved_metadata AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid), top_memory_range_display_names AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key, tmr.display_name AS top10_display_name, tmr.memory_mb_range, tmr.memory_mb_variance, tmr.memory_mb_stddev, tmr.has_active_info_cache FROM shelved_metadata AS sm JOIN top_memory_range_display_names AS tmr ON sm.display_name = tmr.display_name ORDER BY tmr.memory_mb_range DESC, sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid

target_disjoint_workload.question: For completed migrations where the instance display name matches the pattern 'prime', return the migration status, the instance display name, the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the time (in days) between instance creation and the last update of its instance info cache (computed over non-deleted instances), the cached network info, and the row number ordered by instance display name using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow AS (SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(t1.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime')) SELECT cpm.migration_status, cpm.instance_display_name, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cpm.instance_network_info, cpm.window_column FROM CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow AS cpm JOIN CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName AS cov ON cov.display_name = cpm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC, cpm.instance_display_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances with display name equal to 'forge' whose memory in MB is greater than the average memory in MB of all 'forge' instances, show the instance display name, instance UUID, instance memory in MB, cached network info, cache record ID, and the average instance memory in MB within the display name group (ordered by memory), along with that display name’s coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance memory (computed over non-deleted instances with system metadata), the number of system metadata rows for the display name, and the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH forge_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), DisplayNameAverages AS (SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), display_name_cov AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON
