ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name, (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT faa.display_name, faa.uuid, faa.memory_mb, faa.network_info, faa.cache_id, faa.window_column, dnc.coefficient_of_variation, dnc.system_metadata_rows, dnc.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM forge_above_avg AS faa JOIN display_name_cov AS dnc ON dnc.display_name = faa.display_name ORDER BY faa.memory_mb

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many distinct instances in availability zone flare3 both (1) have non-deleted image_image_type system metadata values whose instance counts are above the average across all non-deleted image_image_type values, and (2) belong to one of the top 10 instance display names by number of network info cache records in flare3; and how many distinct display names meet both conditions? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH image_type_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.VALUE ORDER BY t1.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t0.DELETED = 0), ValueCounts AS (SELECT metadata_value, COUNT(*) AS value_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_value), AvgValueCount AS (SELECT AVG(value_instance_count * 1.0) AS avg_value_instance_count FROM ValueCounts) SELECT i.instance_uuid, i.instance_display_name, i.metadata_value, i.network_info FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ValueCounts AS vc ON i.metadata_value = vc.metadata_value WHERE vc.value_instance_count > (SELECT avg_value_instance_count FROM AvgValueCount)), top10_display_names_flare3 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ita.instance_uuid) AS matching_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t10.display_name) AS matching_display_name_count FROM image_type_above_avg AS ita JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.uuid = ita.instance_uuid JOIN top10_display_names_flare3 AS t10 ON t10.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances whose system metadata key is image_image_type, show (by instance display name) the average memory (MB) and memory standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) for display names matching the pattern prime (including subtotals and a grand total), and for those same display names also list the metadata value and cached network info for instances hosted on blaze8-12, including the instance UUID and the instance info cache record ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP), host_metadata_network AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, iic.ID AS instance_info_cache_id FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_stddev, hmn.metadata_value, hmn.network_info, hmn.window_column, hmn.instance_uuid, hmn.instance_info_cache_id FROM mem_stats AS ms JOIN host_metadata_network AS hmn ON hmn.display_name = ms.display_name WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(ms.display_name, 'prime')

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each non-deleted instance display name matching the pattern 'prime' (and with a non-deleted network info cache record), show the display name, total number of qualifying instances, average instance memory (MB), variance of instance memory (MB), and the maximum (worst-case) standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the network info cache update lag (in days) for that display name, including a grand total row. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY display_sort, display_name) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, total_instances, avg_memory_mb, memory_mb_variance FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.display_name END AS display_name, COUNT(i.id) AS total_instances, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ic.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY display_sort, display_name), lag_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS avg_cache_update_lag, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) AS cache_update_lag_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_update_lag_stddev DESC) SELECT display_name, MAX(cache_update_lag_stddev) AS max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name) SELECT mem_stats.display_name, mem_stats.total_instances, mem_stats.avg_memory_mb, mem_stats.memory_mb_variance, lag_stats.max_cache_update_lag_stddev FROM mem_stats LEFT JOIN lag_stats ON lag_stats.display_name = mem_stats.display_name ORDER BY mem_stats.display_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances with display name equal to 'forge', list each instance’s project ID (with per-project subtotal rows), instance ID, UUID, user ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, and the related instance-info-cache record ID and network info; also show the minimum memory (MB) within each project, the per-project total forge instance count and average memory (MB), plus the running average memory (MB) within the 'forge' display-name group ordered by memory, along with the overall total number of 'forge' instances and overall average memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column, forge_stats.total_forge_instances, forge_stats.avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(project_name) OVER (ORDER BY project_sort, project_name) = project_name THEN NULL ELSE project_name END AS project_id, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, availability_zone, info_cache_id, network_info, window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, total_instances, avg_memory_mb FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE project_id END AS project_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE project_id END AS project_name, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, availability_zone, info_cache_id, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) AS total_instances, AVG(memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, availability_zone, info_cache_id, network_info, window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY project_sort, project_name, instance_id) SELECT q2.project_id, q2.instance_id, q2.instance_uuid, q2.user_id, q2.hostname, q2.vm_state, q2.power_state, q2.memory_mb, q2.vcpus, q2.availability_zone, q2.info_cache_id, q2.network_info, q2.min_memory_mb_in_project, q2.total_instances AS total_forge_instances_in_project, q2.avg_memory_mb AS avg_forge_memory_mb_in_project, q1.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, q1.total_forge_instances AS total_forge_instances_overall, q1.avg_forge_memory_mb AS avg_forge_memory_mb_overall FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.instance_uuid = q1.uuid ORDER BY q2.project_id, q2.instance_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For all non-deleted instances whose VM state is one of the “high total memory” VM states (where the VM-state total memory across non-deleted instances exceeds the overall average instance memory plus one standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP)), list each instance’s ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and info cache record ID, along with the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (by instance ID), the total non-deleted instances in that project, the average of those per-project totals across projects, and also the VM-state total memory and the (avg + stddev) threshold value. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH vm_state_memory_thresholds AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0)) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, threshold_stats.avg_plus_stddev AS avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(i3.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i3.memory_mb) AS avg_plus_stddev FROM `instances` AS i3 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid WHERE i3.deleted = 0) AS threshold_stats), instance_project_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id) SELECT ips.instance_id, ips.instance_uuid, ips.user_id, ips.project_id, ips.display_name, ips.vm_state, ips.memory_mb, ips.vcpus, ips.info_cache_id, ips.max_instance_id_next_2, ips.total_instances_in_project, ips.avg_instance_count, vst.total_memory_mb AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, vst.avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM instance_project_window_stats AS ips JOIN vm_state_memory_thresholds AS vst ON ips.vm_state = vst.vm_state ORDER BY ips.instance_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances whose display name is "forge", show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, the related instance-info-cache record ID and network info, and the minimum memory (MB) within each project (partitioned and ordered by project ID), along with the total number of "forge" instances per project and the average of those per-project "forge" instance counts across all projects. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_id) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.project_id) AS total_forge_instances_in_project, avg_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(forge_instance_count) AS avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS per_project_counts) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the top 10 projects with the highest total instance memory (considering only non-deleted instances), list each project’s ID, its total memory used (MB), and whether it has any instance whose memory-based dense rank (using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows) equals 1; for every non-deleted instance in those projects, also show the instance ID, UUID, user ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance info cache record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), plus the total number of non-deleted instances in that project and the average of those per-project totals across all projects. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH top_projects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON ic.uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND ic.window_column = 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_rank1_instance_by_window FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ORDER BY total_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), instance_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id) SELECT tp.project_id, tp.total_memory_mb, tp.has_rank1_instance_by_window, id.instance_id, id.instance_uuid, id.user_id, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.info_cache_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, id.total_instances_in_project, id.avg_instance_count FROM top_projects AS tp JOIN instance_details AS id ON id.project_id = tp.project_id ORDER BY tp.total_memory_mb DESC, id.instance_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For the instance with UUID '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc', list its instance ID, display name, user ID, project ID, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, and each system metadata key/value (including the minimum metadata ID per key via a window function). Also include—based on that same display name—the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of non-deleted system metadata entries per instance, and additionally show the total vCPUs and total memory (MB) consumed by all non-deleted instances that share that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT d.instance_id, d.display_name, d.user_id, d.project_id, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.availability_zone, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_value, d.metadata_id, d.window_column, s.metadata_count_range, s.metadata_count_variance, s.metadata_count_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataDetails AS d JOIN MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS s ON d.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_id) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.display_name, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.metadata_id, ic.window_column, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, agg.total_vcpus_for_display_name, agg.total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_for_display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM `instances` AS i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name) AS agg ON ic.display_name = agg.display_name ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: How many distinct instances in availability zone flare3 both (1) have non-deleted image_image_type system metadata values whose instance counts are above the average across all non-deleted image_image_type values, and (2) belong to one of the top 10 instance display names by number of network info cache records in flare3; and how many distinct display names meet both conditions? Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH image_type_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.VALUE ORDER BY t1.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t0.DELETED = 0), ValueCounts AS (SELECT metadata_value, COUNT(*) AS value_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_value), AvgValueCount AS (SELECT AVG(value_instance_count * 1.0) AS avg_value_instance_count FROM ValueCounts) SELECT i.instance_uuid, i.instance_display_name, i.metadata_value, i.network_info FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ValueCounts AS vc ON i.metadata_value = vc.metadata_value WHERE vc.value_instance_count > (SELECT avg_value_instance_count FROM AvgValueCount)), top10_display_names_flare3 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ita.instance_uuid) AS matching_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t10.display_name) AS matching_display_name_count FROM image_type_above_avg AS ita JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.uuid = ita.instance_uuid JOIN top10_display_names_flare3 AS t10 ON t10.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type, return each instance’s display name, that metadata value, cached network info, and the row-number window value, along with how far the metadata value is from the average across those rows; and for the same instances (restricted to the top 10 prime-matching instances by completed-migration metadata-count range), also show the range/variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of system-metadata rows per completed migration and whether the instance has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS FLOAT)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS FLOAT) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For completed migrations, list the migration ID, instance display name, the instance-memory variance/standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (plus average and max MEMORY_MB) computed only for display names that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and whose average MEMORY_MB is greater than 75% of the max MEMORY_MB for that display name; also show each migration row’s system metadata key/value, its row number (ordered by metadata key with a 2-preceding/1-following window frame), the overall average row number benchmark, and whether the row number is above, below, or at that benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC), CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.`KEY` ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, aw.avg_window_column AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > aw.avg_window_column THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_ROWNUM' WHEN ic.window_column < aw.avg_window_column THEN 'BELOW_AVG_ROWNUM' ELSE 'AT_AVG_ROWNUM' END AS rownum_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_window AS aw) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.instance_display_name, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.max_memory_mb, cmr.metadata_key, cmr.metadata_value, cmr.window_column, cmr.benchmark, cmr.rownum_category FROM CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum AS cmr JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cmr.instance_display_name ORDER BY ms.avg_memory_mb DESC, cmr.migration_id, cmr.metadata_key

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances whose display name matches the pattern 'prime' and that are among the top 10 by standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of completed-migration MEMORY_TOTAL (only including display names with more than 5 completed migration records), show the instance display name, its MEMORY_TOTAL standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), whether it has any active (non-completed/non-failed/non-error) non-deleted migrations, and—restricted to those same instances that are on host blaze8-12 with system metadata key image_image_type—also show the instance UUID, the metadata key/value, cached network info, the rolling average instance memory (MB) over 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by metadata value and ordered by created-at), and whether the instance has any other non-deleted system metadata keys besides image_image_type. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism JOIN `instances` AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ism2.`KEY` <> 'image_image_type' AND ism2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_other_system_metadata FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.network_info, q2.avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, q2.has_other_system_metadata FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_total_stddev DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_value

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances running on host 'blaze8-12' (using only non-deleted instance info cache rows and non-deleted system metadata entries for key 'image_image_type'), show the image type, host migration activity label (Active/Inactive), instance display name, the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of root disk size (GB) with rollup subtotals and a grand total, the row count, and (when the display name matches REGEXP 'prime') the maximum completed-migration memory_total observed for that display name (only when that maximum is greater than 0). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Enriched AS (SELECT ic.display_name, ism2.value AS image_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m WHERE (m.source_compute = i.host OR m.dest_compute = i.host) AND m.deleted = 0 AND NOT m.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS host_migration_status, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism2.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism2.deleted = 0 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic2 ON iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(image_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE host_migration_status END AS host_migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM Enriched GROUP BY image_type, host_migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name) SELECT q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name

target_disjoint_workload.question: For host "blaze8-12", list (with subtotals per VM state and a grand total) the VM state, power state, and number of distinct non-deleted instances (using only non-deleted system metadata rows), and also show for each VM state the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_REMAINING for completed migrations and the count of completed migrations contributing to that statistic. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sr.vm_state, sr.power_state

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances on host blaze8-12 whose system metadata key is image_image_type, return the instance UUID, instance display name, metadata key and value, cached network info, and the windowed average instance memory (MB) over 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by metadata value and ordered by instance created-at), but only for rows where that windowed average is above the overall average of the same windowed average; additionally, only keep instances whose display name is among the top 10 (matching the regular expression prime) with the most image_image_type system metadata records (considering only non-deleted instances), and include each such display name’s metadata record count and its deviation from the top-10 average. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism JOIN `instances` AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, metadata_key, metadata_value, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY window_column DESC, instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.network_info, q1.window_column, q2.metadata_records, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.window_column DESC, q2.metadata_records DESC, q1.instance_uuid

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12” that also have completed migrations on the same host, list the instance hostname and UUID, instance extra ID, system metadata key/value, the running average instance memory (MB) by metadata key, whether the instance has any deleted system metadata, and the related migration details (migration id, source/destination compute, display name, running average migration id, total metadata rows, and average running-average migration id). Also compute a normalized ratio of average running-average migration id divided by the running-average instance memory, and sort by this ratio descending.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), instance_rollup AS (SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ir.total_metadata_rows, ir.avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instance_rollup AS ir ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key) SELECT q2.hostname, q2.instance_uuid, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS running_avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.has_deleted_system_metadata, q1.migration_id, q1.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q1.DEST_COMPUTE, q1.instance_display_name, q1.window_column AS running_avg_migration_id, q1.total_metadata_rows, q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id, ROUND(q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id / NULLIF(q2.window_column, 0), 6) AS normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.INSTANCE_UUID = q2.instance_uuid AND q1.metadata_key = q2.metadata_key AND q1.metadata_value = q2.metadata_value ORDER BY normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q1.migration_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12" that are also non-deleted and have more than 16 GB of memory, show each instance UUID and display name along with its memory (MB), vCPUs, extra flavor JSON, system metadata key/value, the row number within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID, the total rows for that metadata key and the average rows per key across all keys, and the dense rank for that same metadata key. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.`KEY`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.FLAVOR, inner_cte.`KEY`, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.MEMORY_MB > 16384) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.flavor, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.window_column AS row_number_within_key_by_uuid, q1.total_rows_for_key, q1.avg_rows_per_key, q2.window_column AS dense_rank_within_key, q2.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb_gt_16gb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.INSTANCE_UUID = q1.instance_uuid AND q2.`KEY` = q1.metadata_key ORDER BY q1.metadata_key, q1.instance_uuid

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances whose memory utilization per vCPU is greater than 2048 MB per vCPU, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, system metadata key and value, and the maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA row ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance UUID, considering only instances that are not deleted and system metadata rows that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > 2048

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each instance display name and image type (from system metadata key = 'image_image_type'), return the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) divided by average) of the instance root disk size in GB, considering only instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and only non-deleted instance info cache rows. Include subtotals per display name and a grand total. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), DisplayNameImageTypeStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.value HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, SUM(instance_count) AS total_instances FROM DisplayNameImageTypeStats GROUP BY display_name, image_type WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY GROUPING(display_name), display_name, GROUPING(image_type), image_type

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each security group, list the security group name and its coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of rule port-range sizes (standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of (to_port − from_port) divided by the average of (to_port − from_port)), but only return those security groups whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the overall average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all non-deleted security groups and non-deleted rules, considering only enabled instance types (instance_types.disabled = false). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.name, STDDEV(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port) / NULLIF(AVG(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.id = sgr.parent_group_id JOIN `instance_types` AS it ON 1 = 1 WHERE sg.deleted = 0 AND sgr.deleted = 0 AND it.disabled = FALSE GROUP BY sg.name HAVING AVG(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cov FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT avg_cov FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances whose display name is "forge", list the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, hostname, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, availability zone, the related instance-info-cache record ID and network info, the minimum memory (MB) within each project, and (for that same VM state) the variance of migration memory total for migrations associated with instances that are not deleted. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH VMStateMigrationMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT fid.instance_id, fid.instance_uuid, fid.USER_ID, fid.PROJECT_ID, fid.HOSTNAME, fid.VM_STATE, fid.POWER_STATE, fid.MEMORY_MB, fid.VCPUS, fid.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fid.info_cache_id, fid.NETWORK_INFO, fid.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, vmmv.memory_total_variance FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS fid JOIN VMStateMigrationMemoryVariance AS vmmv ON fid.VM_STATE = vmmv.VM_STATE ORDER BY vmmv.memory_total_variance DESC, fid.PROJECT_ID, fid.instance_id

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each instance display name that matches the pattern 'flare' and has a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type', show the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of days from creation to launch, and also show how many non-deleted instances with that display name are on host 'blaze8-12' along with their average memory (MB) and average vCPU count; then, for each such display name, report the maximum of the per-project host instance counts (i.e., the largest number of those host instances contributed by any single project). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DaysToLaunchStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'flare') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), HostInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT hi.uuid) AS host_instance_count, AVG(hi.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb_on_host, AVG(hi.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus_on_host FROM HostInstances AS hi JOIN DaysToLaunchStats AS dls ON hi.display_name = dls.display_name GROUP BY hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev ORDER BY dls.days_to_launch_stddev DESC), PerProjectHostCounts AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS host_instances_in_project FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'flare') GROUP BY i.display_name, i.project_id) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host, MAX(pphc.host_instances_in_project) AS max_host_instance_count_in_any_project FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN PerProjectHostCounts AS pphc ON pphc.display_name = ic.display_name GROUP BY ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host ORDER BY ic.days_to_launch_stddev DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12”, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, and the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and also include (when available) the root disk size (ROOT_GB) range and variance computed per display name for instances that have system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type' and are hosted on “prime-35”. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CombinedInstanceView AS (SELECT idfb.instance_uuid, idfb.display_name, idfb.vm_state, idfb.power_state, idfb.memory_mb, idfb.vcpus, idfb.instance_extra_id, idfb.max_instance_id_next_2, rgb.root_gb_range, rgb.root_gb_variance FROM InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS idfb LEFT JOIN RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS rgb ON rgb.DISPLAY_NAME = idfb.display_name) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY instance_uuid

target_disjoint_workload.question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 display names by number of completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID and only for instances with a non-empty key name), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, the completed migrations count, the completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio rounded, and keep only those rows whose completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio is greater than the overall average completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio across the same result set.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > (SELECT avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: From the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance memory (considering only non-deleted instance info cache records), display the instance display name, its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and for each matching non-deleted instance that has system metadata key = 'image_image_type' also show the instance UUID, availability zone, metadata entry count, total vCPUs, and whether the instance has a config drive enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH mem_stats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), meta_vcpu AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), top10_by_variance AS (SELECT display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM mem_stats ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT t.display_name, t.memory_mb_variance, t.memory_mb_stddev, mv.instance_uuid, mv.availability_zone, mv.metadata_entry_count, mv.total_vcpus FROM top10_by_variance AS t JOIN meta_vcpu AS mv ON t.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY t.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, c.instance_uuid, c.availability_zone, c.metadata_entry_count, c.total_vcpus, CASE WHEN i.config_drive IN ('True', 'true', '1', 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_config_drive FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.memory_mb_variance DESC

AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS (SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i2 WHERE ed.dest_compute, ed.total_rows_in_dest_compute, ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, bh.instance_host AS blaze_instance_host, bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS target_disjoint_workload.question: For instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and that have completed migrations, return only those instances that (1) have at least one (display name, migration status, created-at) group whose maximum migration MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than the overall average of these per-group maxima (and greater than 0), and (2) have an average instance MEMORY_MB (for completed, not-deleted instances) greater than the overall average of those per-instance averages; show the instance display name, migration status, per-group maximum MEMORY_TOTAL, migration created timestamp, minimum migration ID, and average instance memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH Q1_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), AvgOfGroupMax AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) AS avg_group_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT avg_group_max_memory_total FROM AvgOfGroupMax)), Q2_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.status, q1.max_memory_total, q1.created_at, q2.min_migration_id, q2.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM Q1_inner_cte AS q1 JOIN Q2_inner_cte AS q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each migration status and instance VM state where the instance has system metadata key 'image_image_type' and the migration is not hidden, show the migration count, the minimum instance memory (MB), the number of instances involved, and the minimum migration total memory. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH q1 AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), q2 AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS) SELECT q1.migration_status, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_count, q1.min_instance_memory_mb, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_total FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_status = q2.migration_status AND q1.instance_vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.migration_count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For instance display names that match 'prime' and are on host blaze8-12, and considering only system-metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type' (with at least 2 such metadata rows for the instance), show each instance display name along with (1) the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MIGRATIONS.MEMORY_TOTAL across its migrations and (2) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of its ROOT_GB; additionally, include the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MIGRATIONS.DISK_TOTAL across its migrations. target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.memory_total_stddev, sq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.display_name = sq2.display_name ORDER BY sq1.memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, STDDEV(m.disk_total) AS disk_total_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN `migrations` AS m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_stddev DESC

target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH MigrationCompleted AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT mc.instance_uuid, mc.instance_display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, mc.instance_hostname, mc.migration_source_compute, mc.migration_dest_compute, mc.migration_dest_host, mc.migration_type, mc.memory_total, mc.memory_processed, mc.memory_remaining, mc.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_per_instance_uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(mc.memory_processed / NULLIF(mc.memory_total, 0), 4) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM MigrationCompleted AS mc JOIN InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw ON imw.uuid = mc.instance_uuid ORDER BY memory_processed_ratio DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For host blaze8-12, find instances that both (1) have a completed migration and (2) have system metadata key image_image_type. target_disjoint_workload.question: For completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12' where the instance display name matches the pattern 'flare', for each migration type list the number of completed migrations, the average instance memory (MB), the average instance vCPUs, the average of the per-type minimum migration memory_total (from the windowed minimum), and the average running average of migration id (from the windowed running average).
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(hcm.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC

target_disjoint_workload.question: For host 'blaze8-12', list all completed migrations (migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, memory MB, vcpus, and instance extra record id), including the per-migration-type minimum MEMORY_TOTAL (as a window value), and also attach (by instance display name) the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of instance MEMORY_MB for instances that have a non-deleted system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS cm LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id, DISPLAY_NAME

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each quota usage record that has a matching reservation, show the quota usage id, project id, resource, in-use amount, reserved amount, and the reservation UUID, and also compute the maximum reservation delta considering the current row and the next 2 rows when rows are ordered by reservation id. Only include rows where the in-use amount is greater than the average in-use amount for the same resource across all non-deleted quota usage records. Do not return any rounded answers.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT q.ID AS quota_usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, q.IN_USE, q.RESERVED, r.UUID AS reservation_uuid, MAX(r.DELTA) OVER (ORDER BY r.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_delta_next_2 FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.DELETED = 0), ResourceInUseAverages AS (SELECT q2.RESOURCE, AVG(q2.IN_USE * 1.0) AS avg_in_use FROM `quota_usages` AS q2 WHERE q2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY q2.RESOURCE) SELECT i.quota_usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.IN_USE, i.RESERVED, i.reservation_uuid, i.max_delta_next_2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ResourceInUseAverages AS a ON a.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE WHERE i.IN_USE > (SELECT a2.avg_in_use FROM ResourceInUseAverages AS a2 WHERE a2.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE)

target_disjoint_workload.question: For each quota usage record with a positive in-use amount, list the quota usage ID, project ID, and resource type, along with the number of linked reservations and the total reserved delta across those reservations (only including reservations that expired before 2021-11-16 19:30:59). Also show, for that resource type, the variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of reservation delta values, and compute the average reserved delta per reservation (total reserved delta divided by reservation count). Finally, include subtotals per resource type and a grand total across all resources, ordering the detailed rows by delta variance descending.
target_disjoint_workload.sql: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH UsageReservationStats AS (SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS
